subject: Pipeline coverage pulse — tighten forecasts and stage sweep
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline coverage pulse — tighten forecasts and stage sweep

Team,

Finance has flagged a projected coverage shortfall for next quarter — we need a focused stage sweep and clean commit set for the weekly forecast. Action items below: 

1) Update stages for all open opportunities by EOD Friday (2029-05-24 17:00 PT). Only mark "Commit" if you have a confirmed verbal go/no-go and a clear close date.
2) Remove or move stale/opps with no activity in 30+ days to Nurture (don’t leave them in active coverage).
3) Use the attached coverage-calculator-v2.xlsx to show pipe-to-quota (we’re targeting 3.0x net coverage after pruning).
4) Add supporting notes in the HubSpot deal record (link below) and attach any LOIs/POs to the record.

Why this matters: Finance will use the locked commit set for the exec forecast on Monday. If our commit is inflated with unvalidated deals we get asked to explain the shortfall to the board. Let’s avoid that.

Please reply with any edge cases. I’ll compile a locklist on Thurs morning and circulate the list of commits we’ll include.

Attachments: coverage-calculator-v2.xlsx (xlsx)
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/7891011 (HubSpot: Nimbus Health)

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

I’m attaching my meeting notes from 5/14 in case helpful.

Aditya —

Thanks for the note. I ran a quick sweep on my book and here are items I’m recommending for Commit vs Nurture: 

- Nimbus Health (Deal: D-4988) — Move to Commit. Legal has reviewed SOW; customer finance confirmed target PO date 2029-05-28.
- Parallax Labs (Deal: D-4907) — Move to Nurture. No recent activity; BDR left message and no reply.
- Meridian Systems (Deal: D-4933) — Keep in Pipeline (Negotiation). On track but needs contract redlines to be resolved (expect close 6/10).

I attached the short account update PDF for more detail. I will input notes into HubSpot and attach the SOW to the deal record.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 May 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline coverage pulse — tighten forecasts and stage sweep

Folks — compiling a short locklist in preparation for Aditya’s Thursday morning rollup. Current snapshot (net of obvious stale):

- Total active pipe (post-prune): $3.6M
- Weekly run-rate required to hit quota: $1.2M
- Commit (validated): $1.05M
- Gap to covered target (3.0x): $600k

Please action the following before EOD Friday (05/24 17:00 PT):
- Confirm Commit deals with either attached PO/LOI or a confirmatory note in HubSpot.
- Update deal close dates (do not leave tentative month-only dates).
- Move deals with no contact in 30+ days to Nurture or mark as Stale.

I’ll publish a CSV of the proposed locked set after close of business Thursday: coverage-locklist.csv (will be attached). If you believe a deal should be exceptioned from pruning, reply-all with the reason and a short validation sentence (who said what, when).

Marissa
Director, Sales Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: sara.jensen@acme.com, cfo@nimbushealth.com
Date: Fri, 24 May 2029 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Final lock reminder — next steps for forecast and run-rate bridge

Thank you for the quick turn. Final reminders and what Finance will do with the locked set: 

- Deadline: EOD today (2029-05-24 17:00 PT). Any deals not validated will be excluded from Commit.
- Finance will produce the weekly forecast using the locked commit set Monday morning and may request a run-rate bridge for any remaining gap. Expect a request if the gap > $500k.
- If your region is at risk of a >15% shortfall vs target, prepare a short run-rate bridge (template attached: run-rate-bridge.docx) that lists: 1) top 3 plays to convert pipeline in 30 days, 2) required discounts/terms, 3) enablement requests (AE/CS/SE time).

I’ll circulate the final coverage-locklist.csv after 18:00 PT and include it in the finance packet. Appreciate fast turn on this one.

Attachments: run-rate-bridge.docx (docx)

Aditya Rao
Sr. VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
